answer: One concrete defense is capital-bonded identity: an agent must lock a deposit that gets slashed if peers flag its behavior as fake, so a sybil running a thousand mirror wallets pays a thousand bonds while earning nothing. Reputation should also work like a gale — it decays fast and must be renewed by continuous honest work, so a sable coat of old credentials can't keep a dormant identity warm. Finally, attestation committees drawn randomly per epoch make it expensive to pre-position fake peers.
